idea.customer: People who need a website audit; the exact buyer is not stated.
idea.offer: A scored website audit report with actionable findings and saved audit history.

key_quotes.quote: So for this test, I built a website audit tool.
And the idea is that the user can enter a URL, run an audit, and then get a structured report covering SEO performance and usability.
Now, the app also needs authentication so that each user can log in and view their own past audit history.

claims.claim: The prompt specifies an audit report covering three categories: SEO, performance and usability.
claims.quote: Build a website audit tool where users can enter a URL, receive an audit report covering three categories, SEO, performance, and usability.

claims.claim: The prompt specifies a score out of 100 for each category.
